observation: d_min=0.03 — late-time production (2018-2025) is nearly flat at 165-185 bbl/mo (~1.3%/yr actual decline). Lowering d_min from 0.05 to 0.03 allows the fitted curve to flatten at terminal decline, dramatically improving hindcast MAPE from 0.2418 to 0.101. R2 still negative (-4.04) suggesting forecast shape needs work.
b_initial=1.0 — no change. Optimizer converged to identical solution regardless of b_initial starting point. The optimizer is robust to initial b guess for this well.
qi_guess_strategy=peak_value — no change. Optimizer converges to same solution regardless of qi initialization. The fit is dominated by the large number of data points, not the initial guess.

outlier_threshold=0.20 — MAPE worsened from 0.101 to 0.1059. More aggressive outlier rejection (rejection rate dropped from 0.021 to 0.012, paradoxically) and fewer fit months may have removed useful data points that help anchor the late-time trend.

smoothing_window=5 — MAPE improved from 0.101 to 0.085. Wider smoothing reduces the high month-to-month variance (e.g. 2019 swings 87-225 bbl/mo) allowing optimizer to better capture the underlying decline trend. R2 also improved from -4.04 to -2.87.
smoothing_window=6 — slight MAPE regression from 0.085 to 0.0861. Window=5 is the sweet spot; further smoothing over-smooths and loses signal.
outlier_window=5 — no change. Identical results to v6, suggesting the outlier detection is already adequate with window=3 and smoothing_window=5 handles the noise.
di_initial=0.30 — marginal MAPE improvement from 0.085 to 0.0849. Lower initial decline rate closer to actual ~15-18%/yr post-workover decline helped optimizer slightly.

significance_threshold=0.40 — MAPE improved from 0.0849 to 0.0699. Lower threshold detected additional phase changes, reducing fit_months from 321 to 268 (likely fitting only the post-workover phase). R2 improved to -1.96. Trade-off: r2_insample dropped to 0.672 but hindcast accuracy improved significantly.
significance_threshold=0.35 — no change from v10. The phase segmentation is already optimal at 0.40; lowering further doesn't detect any additional meaningful phase boundaries.
peak_merge_distance=5 — no change. Phase segmentation is already stable; larger merge distance has no effect.
